description: We are OrbitX, a Cairo-based team passionate about space exploration, technology, programming, and innovation. We are building an interactive 3D map of Mars for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We love solving problems, learning new skills, and turning ideas into reality. Join us to gain experience, share ideas, and build something impactful. We welcome members interested in Python, JavaScript, 3D modeling, GIS, UI/UX, astronomy, research, and creative problem-solving.
